title: feuilleea alata
intro: Feuilleea alata, commonly known as the winged euodia, is a plant species in the family Rutaceae that is native to the tropical regions of Asia. The bioactive constituents of Feuilleea alata include flavonoids, limonoids, and coumarins, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
